Test Steps: Open login page; leave email empty; submit the form.
Expected Result: Required-field error appears at the specified location.

Test Steps: Enter a valid email; leave password empty; submit.
Expected Result: Password-required error appears.

Test Steps: Enter an invalid email format; submit.
Expected Result: Email-format validation appears.

Test Steps: Enter a registered QA email and an incorrect password; submit.
Expected Result: Authentication fails and the approved error message appears.

Test Steps: Trigger validation errors on multiple fields.
Expected Result: Errors appear beside the relevant fields without overlap.

Test Steps: Submit invalid credentials; inspect the login network response.
Expected Result: Response matches the documented HTTP status and error-code specification.

Test Steps: On the password creation/reset screen, enter a password at the configured minimum length; submit.
Expected Result: Password satisfies the documented minimum-length rule.

Test Steps: Enter a password one character below the configured minimum; submit.
Expected Result: Password is rejected with the documented validation.

Test Steps: Enter a password at the configured maximum length; submit.
Expected Result: Input is handled successfully according to policy.

Test Steps: Attempt to enter a password beyond the configured maximum.
Expected Result: Additional input is prevented or safely rejected; no application error occurs.

Test Steps: Try passwords with and without uppercase/lowercase characters on the password creation screen.
Expected Result: Validation follows the documented complexity policy.

Test Steps: Try passwords with and without numeric characters.
Expected Result: Validation follows the documented numeric-character requirement.

Test Steps: Try passwords with and without special characters.
Expected Result: Validation follows the documented special-character requirement.

Test Steps: Open the applicable password creation/reset screen; enter passwords of different strengths.
Expected Result: Strength indicator appears on the specified screen and reflects the documented levels.

Test Steps: Enter a password; toggle visibility if the control is available.
Expected Result: Password switches between masked and visible states correctly.

Test Steps: Submit login credentials over HTTPS; inspect the request in browser developer tools.
Expected Result: Credentials are sent only over encrypted transport and are not exposed in URLs or client logs.

Test Steps: Log in; navigate between authenticated pages while remaining active.
Expected Result: Session remains active according to the documented policy.

Test Steps: Log in; remain inactive until the configured idle timeout elapses.
Expected Result: Session expires or reauthentication is required as specified.

Test Steps: Log in; perform an application action shortly before idle timeout.
Expected Result: Session timer behaves according to the documented activity-reset policy.

Test Steps: Log in and continue periodic activity until the configured absolute limit.
Expected Result: Session expires at the documented absolute limit even if activity continues.

Test Steps: Allow session to expire; open or refresh a protected dashboard URL.
Expected Result: User is redirected to login or prompted to reauthenticate; protected data is not exposed.

Test Steps: Select Remember Me; log in successfully; close and reopen the browser.
Test Data: Valid QA account; Remember Me selected
Expected Result: Persistence matches the documented Remember Me duration and behaviour.

Test Steps: Log in without selecting Remember Me; close and reopen the browser.
Test Data: Valid QA account; Remember Me not selected
Expected Result: Session follows the documented default persistence policy.

Test Steps: Log in with Remember Me; fully close and reopen the browser; revisit the application.
Expected Result: Authentication persistence matches the documented policy.

Test Steps: Select Remember Me; log in; log out; revisit a protected page.
Expected Result: Session is invalidated and protected pages require authentication.

Test Steps: Log in; inspect authentication-related cookies in browser developer tools.
Expected Result: Cookie attributes meet the approved Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite requirements.

Test Steps: Submit incorrect credentials repeatedly using an approved test account.
Expected Result: Failed attempts are counted and handled according to policy.

Test Steps: Submit incorrect credentials until one attempt below the configured threshold.
Expected Result: Account/request behaves according to the pre-lockout policy.

Test Steps: Submit incorrect credentials until the exact configured threshold is reached.
Expected Result: Account or request is restricted at the documented boundary.

Test Steps: Continue submitting incorrect credentials after the threshold is reached.
Expected Result: Further attempts are handled according to lockout/rate-limit policy.

Test Steps: Attempt login during the configured lockout period.
Expected Result: Login remains restricted for the documented duration.

Test Steps: Wait until the configured lockout period ends; attempt login with valid credentials.
Expected Result: Account recovery follows the documented policy.

Test Steps: Attempt login with correct credentials while the test account is locked.
Expected Result: Behaviour matches the documented lockout policy.

Test Steps: Generate repeated login requests in the approved test environment.
Expected Result: Server enforces configured request limits and returns the documented response.

Test Steps: Trigger a lockout and inspect the user-facing response.
Expected Result: Correct lockout message appears without revealing sensitive account information.

Test Steps: Log in to a dedicated QA account; open security settings; enable 2FA; complete required verification.
Expected Result: 2FA is enabled only after successful verification.

Test Steps: Enter valid primary credentials for a 2FA-enabled account.
Expected Result: Application requests the configured second authentication factor.

Test Steps: Complete primary login; enter a valid, current OTP.
Expected Result: User successfully completes authentication.

Test Steps: Complete primary login; enter an incorrect OTP.
Expected Result: Authentication fails and an appropriate error appears.

Test Steps: Enter an OTP after its configured validity period.
Expected Result: Expired OTP is rejected.

Test Steps: Successfully authenticate with an OTP; attempt to submit the same OTP again where applicable.
Expected Result: Previously consumed OTP is rejected when one-time use is required.

Test Steps: Reach the OTP screen; leave the code blank; submit.
Expected Result: Required-field validation appears and authentication is not completed.

Test Steps: Enter alphabetic characters, special characters or an incorrect number of digits.
Expected Result: Input is validated according to the documented OTP format.

Test Steps: Request an OTP; select Resend OTP; inspect delivery and validity behaviour.
Expected Result: A new OTP is issued according to resend and rate-limit policy.

Test Steps: Open security settings; attempt to disable 2FA and complete required verification.
Expected Result: 2FA is disabled only after the required verification and confirmation.

Test Steps: Open the login page for an account configured for SSO.
Expected Result: SSO entry point is visible and usable according to account configuration.

Test Steps: Select SSO; authenticate using a valid test identity-provider account.
Expected Result: User reaches the authorized VWO workspace.

Test Steps: Start SSO and submit invalid identity-provider credentials.
Expected Result: Authentication fails safely with an appropriate message.

Test Steps: Start the SSO flow and cancel at the identity provider.
Expected Result: User returns to an unauthenticated state.

Test Steps: In a controlled IdP test environment, submit a malformed or invalid SAML response.
Expected Result: Application rejects the response and does not create an authenticated session.

Test Steps: Use a test assertion whose validity period has expired.
Expected Result: Authentication is rejected.

Test Steps: In an authorized test environment, alter the OAuth state parameter before callback.
Expected Result: Callback is rejected to prevent state/CSRF attacks.

Test Steps: Log in through SSO; log out of VWO; test the resulting application and IdP sessions.
Expected Result: Logout behaviour matches the configured service-provider and identity-provider policy.

Test Steps: Attempt to configure an identity provider not supported by the product.
Expected Result: Configuration is rejected with a clear, safe error.

Test Steps: Open login page; select Forgot Password.
Expected Result: Password recovery page opens.

Test Steps: Enter a registered QA email on the recovery page; submit.
Expected Result: Reset instructions are sent according to the configured workflow.

Test Steps: Enter an unregistered email; submit.
Expected Result: Response does not unnecessarily reveal whether an account exists.

Test Steps: Enter an invalid email format; submit.
Expected Result: Email-format validation appears.

Test Steps: Open a current, valid reset link from the QA mailbox.
Expected Result: Password reset page opens and allows the permitted reset flow.

Test Steps: Open a reset link after its configured validity period.
Expected Result: Token is rejected and a safe recovery path is offered.

Test Steps: Complete a password reset; open the same reset link again.
Expected Result: Previously consumed token is rejected.

Test Steps: Modify characters in the reset token URL and open it.
Expected Result: Token is rejected and no password change occurs.

Test Steps: Request a reset email; inspect sender, subject, branding, instructions and link.
Expected Result: Email content matches the approved template and contains a secure reset link.

Test Steps: Request multiple reset links; test each link according to the token invalidation policy.
Expected Result: Token validity and invalidation behaviour match documented requirements.

Test Steps: Open login page; inspect the primary submit control.
Expected Result: Button label matches the approved UI specification.

Test Steps: Inspect the recovery link and activate it.
Expected Result: Label matches the approved specification and navigation works.

Test Steps: Inspect the SSO control on an SSO-enabled account.
Expected Result: Label matches the approved SSO UI specification.

Test Steps: Inspect the Google authentication control.
Expected Result: Provider branding and label match approved UI requirements.

Test Steps: Leave email blank; enter a password; submit.
Expected Result: Appropriate required-field validation appears.

Test Steps: Enter an email; leave password blank; submit.
Expected Result: Appropriate required-field validation appears.

Test Steps: Enter and remove values from the login fields; observe the submit button.
Expected Result: Button state follows the approved UI behaviour.

Test Steps: Use Tab, Shift+Tab and Enter to navigate and operate login controls.

Test Steps: Open login page and execute basic login validation in a supported Firefox version.

Test Steps: Open login page and execute basic login validation in a supported Edge version.

Test Steps: Set browser zoom to 200 percent and inspect the login page.

Test Steps: Monitor the login endpoint over the agreed measurement window.
Expected Result: Measured availability meets the agreed uptime SLA.

Test Steps: Map all P0 requirements to test cases.
Expected Result: All critical requirements have appropriate test coverage.

Test Steps: Link requirements to test cases and defects in the test management tool.
Expected Result: Traceability is complete and links are accurate.

Test Steps: Review execution results against approved entry/exit criteria.
Expected Result: Release recommendation follows approved criteria and unresolved-risk rules.

Test Steps: Inspect authorized audit records across the configured retention boundary.
